candidates.settlement_scope: Assumed standard rules; not yet checked against this book's published rules. Standard full-game only; verify local rules and market exceptions
candidates.model_status: Experimental independent forecast; no validated betting edge

inputs.label: Projected ice time
inputs.detail: Prior-adjusted workload estimate

inputs.label: Weighted assists / 60
inputs.detail: Prior-adjusted production per 60 minutes

inputs.label: Opponent goals allowed / game
inputs.detail: Recency-weighted; the same figure the game-line model uses

inputs.label: His results vs. our forecasts
inputs.detail: 228 actual vs. 218.7 forecast points in earlier games; shrunk toward 1

steps.label: Opponent goals allowed vs. long-run league average
His results vs. our past forecasts

build.note: Ice time × production per 60 minutes, both recency-weighted and blended with a position average, then scaled by how many goals the opponent allows compared with the league. Then adjusted for how he has done against our own forecasts: 228 points against 218.7 forecast in his earlier games, shrunk toward no adjustment. The model then turns this average into the chance of each count.

blend.label: Production rate
blend.detail: Recency-weighted games; the rest is the position average

blend.label: Ice time
blend.detail: Recency-weighted games; the rest is the position average

trend.label: assists
trend.note: Faded games count less. A game’s weight halves every 110 of his games for production and every 14 of his games for ice time.

missing: The starting goalie (team defense blends its goalies)

versus.note: History only, not a model input. In our backtests, results against one opponent did not predict the next meeting beyond a player’s overall form.

player_context.note: Newer appearances carry more weight. Ice time has a 14-appearance half-life; production per minute has a 110-appearance half-life. The offseason does not age player history. Expected shots scale with the opponent’s shots allowed, and scoring with its goals allowed, relative to the league. A player who has consistently beaten (or missed) our earlier forecasts gets a shrunk adjustment toward that record. Observed averages below are unweighted.
